title: PROJECTMEM: A Local-First, Event-Sourced Memory and Judgment Layer for AI Coding Agents
abstract: arXiv:2606.12329v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: AI coding agents often lose project-specific rationale across sessions and may repeat approaches that previously failed. The bottleneck is often not model capability but missing coding agent memory: a durable record of what was decided, tried, and ruled out. We present projectmem, an open-source, local-first memory and judgment layer for AI coding agents, which records development as an append-only, plain-text log of typed events (issues, attempts, fixes, decisions, and notes) and deterministically projects it into compact summaries served through the Model Context Protocol (MCP). When invoked before an edit, a file-scoped advisory precheck returns recorded failures, open issues, and churn for the target file, a design point we call Memory-as-Governance. translated_title: PROJECTMEM：一种面向AI编程智能体的本地优先、事件溯源的记忆与判断层
translated_abstract: AI编程智能体在会话之间常常丢失项目特定的决策依据，并可能重复采用以前失败过的方法。瓶颈往往不在于模型能力，而在于缺少编程智能体记忆：即对已决策、已尝试和已排除方案的持久记录。我们提出了projectmem，一个面向AI编程智能体的开源、本地优先的记忆与判断层，它将开发过程记录为仅追加的纯文本类型化事件日志（问题、尝试、修复、决策和笔记），并确定性地将其投影为紧凑摘要，通过模型上下文协议（MCP）提供服务。在编辑前调用时，文件范围的咨询式预检会返回目标文件的已记录失败、未解决问题和变更频率，我们将这一设计要点称为“记忆即治理”。我们通过作者自发的、在两台机器上进行的为期六个月的自我研究、一项受控延迟基准测试以及客户端兼容性测试来评估其可行性。该研究包含3,228个唯一的……
tldr: projectmem是一个开源、本地优先的记忆与判断层，通过仅追加的事件溯源日志和MCP协议为AI编程智能体提供持久记忆，并在编辑前通过“记忆即治理”式预检帮助避免重复过去的失败。
en_tdlr: Projectmem is an open-source, local-first memory and judgment layer that gives AI coding agents persistent memory via append-only event-sourced logs and MCP, with a Memory-as-Governance precheck that surfaces past failures before edits to avoid repeating them.
